mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lymph vessels into a continuous return route was most worthwhile: it showed where excess fluid goes and explained when it is called lymph.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger lymph vessels to the vein was clear but fairly predictable, especially as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: I learned that fluid is called lymph once it enters lymph vessels, and that returning it helps prevent fluid buildup around cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The later choices were the only offered combinations, but their purpose was clear from the unfinished route and goals.

continue.text: I'd probably continue for another chapter: seeing separate systems come together was satisfying, and the fluid-return route taught me something new. I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final sequence offered.
